payload.title: Evaluate shortlisted encoders on frozen DIP histories and long-document retrieval
payload.description: Distinct follow-up stage to the completed pretrained pilot task_358d32ed-9c7b-453e-a23f-244f00ef174c, within broader alternatives research task_8b4318ef-b13d-4420-988f-5266db4cd215. Test frozen pinned E5 and multilingual MiniLM on real public DIP task/document sources, known adversarial synthetic cases and explicit long-document placement stress. Compare whole/section/hybrid retrieval and read-only persisted index recovery/update behavior. No automatic identity, status mutation, product rollout or full custom training claim.
acceptance: Freeze the two selected revisions, all real/synthetic source snapshots, query labels, strategy definitions and source hashes before scored inference; old synthetic pilot remains exploratory, not a new hidden test.

Compare capable BM25 and the same E5/MiniLM whole-document, bounded section and fixed hybrid retrieval using identical information and authoritative Q-only inputs; score task and source recovery separately from identity or completion.

Include real English/Hebrew queries, long-document stress, same/opposite/expanded requirements and explicit status/version distractors. Report truncation, every scheduled outcome, resource cost and limitations without tuned test thresholds.

Verify persisted derived index load/restart, no model re-encoding when unchanged, incremental changed/deleted source invalidation and corrupt-cache recovery. Cache never replaces canonical source; no real DIP task statuses are altered by inference.

Publish raw outcomes, independent offline score replay and meaningful safety/calibration/index tests through configured verification. Leave independent label review, downstream real-agent quality, full custom training and production neural routing open.
